verses.20:94: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي

meaning: The root لحي (lHy) primarily refers to the jawbone and, by extension, the beard. It can also describe the act of shaving or trimming the beard, or striking someone on the jaw.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
